title: splicelogic: differential transcripts to splice events
text: splicelogic R/Bioconductor package detecting alternative splicing events exon-level data stored GRanges objects. Given set exons annotated coefficient column indicating differential transcript usage (DTU), splicelogic identifies following types splicing events: Skipped exons (SE) – exons skipped -regulated transcripts Included exons (IE) – exons included -regulated transcripts Mutually exclusive exons (MXE) – pairs exons one included another excluded -regulated transcripts compared -regulated transcripts Retained introns (RI) – intronic regions retained part exon -regulated transcripts Alternative 5’ (A5SS) – exons -regulated transcripts share 3’ splice site differ 5’ splice site exons -regulated transcripts Alternative 3’ (A3SS) – , differing 3’ splice site detected using series functions, e.g. find_se(), find_ie(), etc. described .

Positive values indicate -regulated exons negative values indicate -regulated exons. exons transcript share value column.

title: splicelogic: differential transcripts to splice events
text: splicelogic designed operate downstream differential transcript usage (DTU). DTU methods test whether relative proportions transcripts within gene differ experimental conditions. general, upstream method produces transcript-resolved differential usage statistics can used splicelogic, provided results include: per-transcript directional effect estimate (e.g. model coefficient, change isoform fraction, deltaPSI, etc.), adjusted p-value (equivalent significance metric thresholding). Common upstream methods include: satuRn — fits quasi-binomial generalized linear models transcript usage proportions performs scalable transcript-level DTU testing. Particularly well suited larger datasets. DRIMSeq — models transcript proportions within genes using Dirichlet-multinomial framework, gene-level transcript-level testing. BANDITS — Bayesian hierarchical DTU method models transcript usage Dirichlet-multinomial explicitly accounts mapping uncertainty using equivalence classes, gene-level transcript-level testing. DEXSeq — primarily differential exon usage (DEU) method based negative binomial GLMs, commonly used transcript-level DTU workflows. log2FC coefficients DEXSeq can used directly splicelogic. limma edgeR (diffSplice / diffSpliceDGE) — can used DTU analyses (well exon-level), gene-level transcript-level testing. Regardless method used, per-transcript DTU statistics (effect estimates adjusted p-values) mapped onto individual exons transcript produce exon-level GRanges (see Obtaining exon ranges). annotated GRanges starting point splicelogic, beginning preprocess() followed event-specific functions (find_se(), find_ie(), etc.).

what: splicelogic: differential transcripts to splice events
title: splicelogic: differential transcripts to splice events
text: splicelogic R/Bioconductor package detecting alternative splicing events exon-level data stored GRanges objects. Given set exons annotated coefficient column indicating differential transcript usage (DTU), splicelogic can used identify variety splicing events. See vignette details.

title: splicelogic: differential transcripts to splice events
text: splicelogic submitted Bioconductor. now can test installing GitHub:
code: devtools::install_github("thelovelab/splicelogic")

title: splicelogic: differential transcripts to splice events
code: # prepare exons from a TxDb and DTU results exons <- prepare_exons(   txdb = <A TxDB OBJECT>,   dtu_table = <DTU_TABLE>,   coef_col = "estimate" )  # preprocess for further analysis exons <- preprocess(exons, coef_col = "estimate")  # find skipped exons skipped <- exons |> find_se()  # find all splicing events all_events <- exons |> find_all_events()

title: splicelogic: differential transcripts to splice events
text: Support detection alternative UTR events (alternative 5’ 3’ UTRs), reference annotation includes UTR coordinates (e.g. GENCODE). Support detection additional event types, consecutive skipped exons loss retained introns. Extraction labelling specific splice junctions associated event, adding metadata columns donor–acceptor dinucleotide sequence (e.g. AG-GT) logical indicating whether junction canonical, downstream interpretation. Facilitating RNA-binding protein (RBP) motif detection. Facilitating interpretation downstream structural consequences.

what: Find splice events from annotated exons — find_events
title: Find splice events from annotated exons — find_events
text: Functions find different types alternative splicing events preprocessed GRanges exon data. Events include skipped exon (se), included exon (ie), mutatualy exclusive exons (mxe), retained intron (ri), alternative 5' 3' splice sites (a5ss / a3ss).

title: Find splice events from annotated exons — find_events
code: find_se(gr, type = c("boundary", "over", "in"), inverse = FALSE)  find_ie(gr, type = c("boundary", "over", "in"))  find_mxe(gr, type = c("boundary", "in", "over"))  find_ri(gr)  find_a5ss(gr)  find_a3ss(gr)  find_all_events(gr, type = c("boundary", "over", "in"), verbose = TRUE)

title: Find splice events from annotated exons — find_events
text: gr GRanges object exon annotations, including 'tx_id', 'exon', 'coef_col' metadata columns preprocessed preprocess(). type type overlap consider identifying events. inverse TRUE, identifies included exons instead skipped exons. verbose TRUE, prints progress messages. Default TRUE.

title: Find splice events from annotated exons — find_events
